systems.system: National geo-referenced digital postal addressing system
systems.country_label: système d'adressage numérique postal géoréférencé; base nationale des adresses numériques et des codes postaux
systems.platform: to be built: open-source GIS and relational database, web management portal, public website and mobile applications, hosted on the client's site in Nouakchott
systems.owner: MTNIMA (WARDIP-Mauritanie, World Bank financing); the Agence Numérique de l'État to host the address database; Mauripost to manage postcodes
systems.tiers: planned, not built: communes are to feed the national address database (street naming, conventional addresses), and a mobile application working online and offline is to equip the mobile terminals of commune staff for field collection

note: Terms of reference for a system still to be built; the communes' part is planned data collection on staff mobile terminals, and nothing is stated about a connection at commune offices. The body is truncated in section 2.8.
